title: Limit staged authored files to 5000 estimated tokens
acceptance_criteria: The pre-commit hook rejects added or modified staged authored blobs over 20000 bytes and accepts the exact boundary, without reading working-tree file sizes.
Lockfiles and generated or vendored files are excluded using documented staged Git attributes; deletions and submodules are skipped.
Failures list every oversized path and give explicit instructions for splitting code, tests, and documentation, updating references, and staging the result.
Temporary Git fixtures cover boundaries, partial staging, exclusions, unusual paths, renames, deletions, and hook execution.
Document installation and activate the hook in this checkout without replacing an existing custom hook setup.

title: Permit focused local verification for small product changes
acceptance_criteria: An automatic staged-diff classifier permits at most five product source/test/guide files and 150 added plus deleted lines; it rejects empty, binary, unknown, configuration, and harness-control changes while excluding queue/progress evidence from size counts.
Small changes retain focused tests, type and lint checks, independent digest-bound review, and post-approval snapshot/state/binding checks; full CI remains mandatory before merge.
Risky semantics including security, persistent data, concurrency, and delivery logic disqualify a change through explicit reviewer confirmation; uncertain scope uses the normal lane.
Focused contracts prove boundary classification, Git baseline/staging behavior, and refusal of control changes; existing full-gate commands and CI remain unchanged.
Primary agent, completion, review, and verification instructions explain eligibility and avoid duplicate unchanged local checks.
